bio: Housed in a stately villa in the Bürgerpark, this restaurant exudes elegance. The open reception area with its gorgeous wooden staircase creates an immediate welcoming impression. High stuccoed ceilings, lovely hardwood floors, muted colours, striking chandeliers and decorative modern pictures make for an atmospheric setting. Waitstaff are friendly and experienced. The menu features brasserie-style dishes inspired by classic French recipes – the bouillabaisse or beef bourguignon are a real treat!...
